title: Glovida-RX
line: Prescriptions that stay up to date.
problem: Prices and medicine details weren't always updating correctly between doctors and pharmacists.
did: I found and fixed the issues so that changes made by one person show up correctly for everyone else.
outcome: Doctors and pharmacists now see accurate information straight away.

story.title: The problem
story.body: Glovida-RX handles prescriptions between doctors and pharmacists. Prices and medicine details weren't always updating correctly between them, so one person could be looking at old information.

story.title: What I did
story.body: I found and fixed the issues, so a change made by one person now shows up correctly for everyone else. I worked with Next.js, React, TypeScript and GraphQL, and used TablePlus to look at the data.

story.title: The result
story.body: Doctors and pharmacists now see accurate information straight away.
